demos.name: Agent Privilege Client LAB
demos.description: A local, no-login test client for an OAuth-protected MCP gateway. Shows one tool call through the gateway and directly, so the policy difference is visible.

demos.name: MCP Demo Client for Privilege LAB
demos.description: Chat-first local MCP demo client for protected MCP demos behind a PingOne Privilege gateway.

demos.name: Privilege A2A Anthropic demo LAB
demos.description: Three Node processes that show an access review through A2A and MCP, on Anthropic or Google models.

demos.name: ID-JAG Standalone LAB
demos.description: Token exchange with ID-JAG, using a mock authorization server and a sample MCP server.

demos.name: Privilege demo LAB
demos.description: An AI agent's MCP tool calls pass a policy enforcement point that decides allow, deny or hold with Cedar. Runs offline in mock mode (in-process mock issuer and tool backends) or verifies Bearer tokens from your own PingFederate in live mode.

demos.name: Privilege Map LAB
demos.description: The PingOne Privilege Federated Identity model as ReactFlow diagrams you can drag and walk through, plus 21 Privilege feature cards, stories and a talk track. Mock only.

demos.name: Agent Meets the MCP Door LAB
demos.description: A member's own AI agent reaches an enterprise MCP door: discover, register, consent, per-call token exchange, gateway, policy decision, human approval, audit. Movable React Flow sequence diagram with a payload or mock token under each message, talk track and presenter mode. Mock only.

demos.name: PingOne Sign-in LAB
demos.description: Sign-in behaviour, mock only: failures, lockout, replay, MFA, step-up (RFC 9470) and CIBA with a mock phone. For real PingOne response shapes and live tenant runs, see the pingone-LAB repo.

demos.name: PingOne LAB
demos.description: A card for each thing PingOne advertises in its discovery document: pi.flow sign-in, PKCE, PAR, JAR, client credentials, token lifecycle, Userinfo, device authorization, CIBA, token exchange, plus a playground. Mock PingOne by default, or your own environment.

demos.name: PingFederate LAB
demos.description: A card for each PingFederate feature behind AI agents: pi.flow sign-in, DCR, RAR with PAR, CIBA, DPoP, token exchange, Userinfo, PAR, PKCE and a protocol playground. Built-in mock PingFederate (offline) or your own PingFederate (live).

demos.name: Customer Agent LAB
demos.description: The customer-facing AI agent with all 87 use cases, each routed Here, Here + go deeper, Hand off or Guide. AI-DEMO2-depth movie reel, sequence view and step detail in movable cards; hand-offs to 30 labs whose Back strip resumes the chat; an A2A page; Scripted or llama.cpp brain. Mock runs offline.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5600). Docker: HOST_PORT=5603 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Settings: the app's own .env beside docker-compose.yml (copy .env.example; Docker reads it with env_file, optional). Live (host-run only, owner opt-in: CAL_ALLOW_LIVE=1, IDP=pingone, PINGONE_ENVIRONMENT_ID, PINGONE_REGION, PINGONE_CLIENT_ID, PINGONE_CLIENT_SECRET in that .env) makes two real calls to one PingOne environment. Live was owner-verified 2026-11-05 with the old shared settings file; it is UNVERIFIED after the move to the app's own .env until the owner re-checks it. Catalog id D24.

demos.name: Agent Kill Switch
demos.description: How an organization stops a runaway AI agent: rate and cost caps that trip automatically, an operator kill switch that revokes access, and the next call failing. Fully mocked; nothing real is touched.

demos.name: Agent Registry Lifecycle
demos.description: Register an AI agent as a non-human identity, grant it to a tool, rotate it by replacement, retire it, and watch the gateway refuse it (401/403/429). Mock only. Optional owner-run live checks compare with a real Privilege console.

demos.name: AI Guard Sidecar
demos.description: How an external guardrail sidecar plugs into an agent gateway: a stand-in detector, per-category block thresholds, PII rails, a fail-closed toggle and a fault injector. Contract unverified; offline.

demos.name: Agent attack gallery
demos.description: Ten named attacks, including MCP authorization attacks, each run ungoverned and governed against an in-process mock stack: see what the attacker gets, then the control that refuses it.

demos.name: CIMD Lab
demos.description: Teaches OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents both ways: real PingFederate as the authorization server (owner-run, no mock), and the lab's own teaching server with a tester that breaks the document in a dozen ways. PingFederate acting as a CIMD client is UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Diagram Studio
demos.description: Pick or edit a flow diagram stored as data: move boxes, Simulate the arrows, change the speed, Reset, undo, tidy, present, embed, and export as JSON, SVG, PNG or one offline HTML file.

demos.name: Gateway Claims Lab
demos.description: What gateway v1.261024 added, in mock: a nested-claim gate (client_id + act.sub via RequiredClaims, including the act-as-text trap) and an AgentCore gateway posture view (shape only, values invented), plus two H2 2026 release tabs (on-behalf-of RFC 8693 exchange, AgentCore gateway governance...

demos.name: Hostile A2A / poisoned Agent Card
demos.description: A deliberately hostile A2A agent, an offline delegating generalist, and a pinned-card client shown side by side with an ungoverned one: the card told my agent to include my token.

demos.name: Hostile MCP / rug-pull
demos.description: A deliberately hostile MCP server, an offline victim, and a pinned client shown side by side with an ungoverned one: the tool that changed overnight.

demos.name: MCP Auth Conformance Lab
demos.description: Score a mock MCP server with selectable defects (or, in a gated read-only probe, one URL you type) against the MCP authorization expectations, with a sourced reference of what ChatGPT and other clients need.

demos.name: MCP Discovery
demos.description: Read-only MCP discovery: finds MCP servers, probes tool metadata, flags poisoned or changed metadata (rug-pull). Demo mode: fixtures and stubs only; live mode points at a server you name. Plus simulated Ping H2 2026 claims (private network, slide 44 personal agents), UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: No tool, no promise
demos.description: A support agent can only commit the company through a tool. Same scripted agent, two tool sets, and a commitment ledger that only tools can write. Mock only: no tenant, no LLM.

demos.name: P1 Third-Party Exchange
demos.description: PingOne token exchange (RFC 8693) that accepts a third-party signed JWT (PingFederate, another PingOne environment, Okta, Auth0, RFC 9068, Microsoft) as the actor token: trusted issuer, assignment, claim mapping, the checks and PingOne's measured refusal texts. Mock only.

demos.name: Personal Agent Flow
demos.description: How an AI assistant reaches a member's benefits through an MCP gateway in twelve steps: discovery, CIMD, consent, signed code exchange, gateway check, policy decision. React Flow sequence diagram, mock token JSON, simulated approval modal, talk track. Mock only.

demos.name: PingGateway Route Lab (simulated)
demos.description: Simulated evaluator, not real PingGateway: which route a request matches and why, the empty-first-param WWW-Authenticate bug, RFC 9728 metadata lint and an RFC 7662 introspection stub. Mock only.

demos.name: Token Workbench
demos.description: Mock-only token workbench: decode and trace a token, test wrong-token rejection, check stub authorization servers against OAuth rules (FAPI 2.0 pack UNVERIFIED), compare PAR/RAR/DPoP/mTLS/JAR/PKCE (simulation).

demos.name: Worker Agent Demo
demos.description: A worker agent acting for a person: attended, delegated (agent to agent) and unattended runs, every tool call through a policy enforcement point that allows, denies or holds for approval; plus an H2 2026 section simulating AgentCard discovery and A2A scope separation (Ping release claims,...

demos.name: Session Lab: PingOne and DaVinci sessions and cookies
demos.description: See the session cookie, the DaVinci sessionToken and the tokens apps hold, then change the session (revoke, shorten idle timeout, require mfa step-up, reuse a sessionToken in a widget) and watch what each app does. React Flow diagram, talk track and presenter mode. Mock only.

demos.name: Intent / PAR Inspector
demos.description: Push an authorization request to a mock server (RFC 9126), watch the intent get bound into the request_uri, consent and token, and see tampering, replay and expiry refused.

demos.name: Poppy Agent Tester
demos.description: Play the personal agent from the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy, Draft 0.3): read a Company's poppy.json, sign in to a real PingFederate with a URL as the client id and PKCE, then call the Company API with a signed Poppy-Session. Every request and token is shown raw.

demos.name: Intent, Purpose and Behaviour Lab
demos.description: Three signals asked of every call (intent, purpose, behaviour), plus on-behalf-of and ID-JAG flows, modelling the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock reads tables; Live signs for real (RS256) locally; a Privilege check sends the call through the live AI Guard on our tenant.

demos.name: Coding Agents LAB
demos.description: Inspection inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and Antigravity: hooks as the enforcement point, the outcome follows the risk. Opens in Real mode — every decision is the live Privilege AI Guard on our tenant; Mock and Live are the offline rehearsal.

demos.name: Data Protection LAB
demos.description: AIGuard content inspection in and out with graduated outcomes, your own gitleaks rules, personal-data kinds with checksums, Agent Insights, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, and sealed prompt logging. Mock reads tables; Live runs locally; a Privilege check sends the text through the live AI Guard.

demos.name: SaaS Access LAB
demos.description: Just-in-time, time-bound access to six platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, Google Workspace): approval chains, blocked self-approval, expiry, receipts, drift. Mock is read-only; Live runs real local state; a Privilege check sends the request through the live AI Guard.

demos.name: Agent Governance LAB
demos.description: AI Platform Agents: cross-cloud inventory of 13 sources, a five-level permission review, custodian approval before any action, remediation, a safe sync that never mistakes silence for deletion, AgentCore gateway governance and private-network discovery. Mock or Live. All product claims UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: MCP Surface LAB
demos.description: The MCP gateway in front of every MCP server: aggregate policy caps, entitlement-aware discovery, OpenAPI to MCP, five backend credential modes, a verified-server catalog, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and CIMD, approval-gated creation. Simulates the 2026-11-02 release claims. Mock or Live. UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Federated Identity LAB
demos.description: Simulates the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims for Federated Identity (short-lived tokens, issuer, subject and audience binding, lifetimes, key refresh, revocation) and Self-Hosted Agents, with real local RS256 verification. Mock tables or a Live local engine. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Secrets Vault LAB
demos.description: A per-user credential vault (self-service, no administrator override, real AES-256-GCM, injected by a simulated gateway) and secret store management over five mock providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Delinea, CyberArk). Mock or Live mode. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.

demos.name: AI Policies LAB
demos.description: Scope and HITL: four layered scope checks (surface, application, action, end user) on a real RS256 token you mint locally, a call held for a person, single-use approvals bound to the exact call, fail closed. Simulates release claims, all UNVERIFIED. Mock tables or a Live local engine.

demos.name: P1AZ Inspector LAB
demos.description: Send decisions to PingOne Authorize and see the verdict, statements and the exact call. One UI runs the offline Mock engine or, owner-run, your own PingOne environment or on-prem PingAuthorize (Live).
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 4840). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4840 only). Catalog B2 is a stand-in (the nearest row, Authorize policy playground): the catalog has no exact row. Mock needs no setup. Live is owner-run and is set up on the Settings page; request and response shapes are UNVERIFIED.

demos.name: Agent Gateway Inspector LAB
demos.description: Inspector for an AI/agent gateway (PingOne Privilege) that allows, denies or holds agent tool calls for a human, with a decision buffer and a verifiable audit trail. Driven by an in-process stub gateway; nothing real is touched. Mock only: Live is refused.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 5850; npm run doctor checks it). Or: HOST_PORT=5850 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock mode only, loopback-only, zero outbound calls; the Live toggle is refused. The composeFile is relative to the folder the demo repos sit in.

demos.name: PingOne MCP Inspector LAB
demos.description: Connect to PingOne's hosted MCP server (worker or interactive admin sign-in) or any MCP server, list its tools with a safety class, and call them read-only by default. Mock by default; Live is owner-run.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 5201; npm run doctor checks it). Or: HOST_PORT=5201 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock mode needs no setup; Live is refused until the owner sets PINGONE_MCP_INSPECTOR_MODE=live. Not tested against a real tenant. The composeFile is relative to the folder the demo repos sit in.

demos.name: Agent Audit Trail LAB
demos.description: Who did what through which agent: seeded synthetic events from six sources, a read-only audit tool surface, and a correlation join into one timeline per action, with a tamper-evident hash chain. Fully mock; Live is refused.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 6600; npm run doctor checks it). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:6600 only; HOST_PORT changes it, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Mock only: the Live toggle explains why it is not available.

demos.name: Progressive trust ladder LAB
demos.description: A personal agent climbs four rungs of trust as risk and amount rise: sign-in, step-up, then a CIBA approval on a mock phone. Mock only, simulated, no tenant. Live is refused: the lab has no live provider.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci, npm run build, npm start (port 6211, PTL_PORT to change within 6200-6249). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1:6211 only). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials, no outbound network. composeFile is relative to the shelf's demo root (the folder that holds the demo repos).

demos.name: AI assistant to MCP authorization flow LAB
demos.description: How a remote MCP server behind an enterprise front door is authorized when a public AI assistant calls it for a signed-in user: connector catalog, PKCE, resource indicators, IdP hand-off, RFC 8693 exchange. 20 messages backed by real mock exchanges. Mock only; product claims UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 6650; mock actors on 6651-6655, MCP_FLOW_STUB_BASE moves them; npm run doctor checks it). Docker: HOST_PORT=6650 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock only; Live is refused. Catalog id D25 is carried over from the old repo and is still a placeholder (to confirm).

demos.name: Mock Authorize LAB
demos.description: A local stand-in for PingOne Authorize: editable rules, a Try page, a decision log, and a PingOne-shaped token, decision and recent-decisions API that clients like the P1AZ Inspector can call. Simulated.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 4850). Docker: HOST_PORT=4850 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock is the only mode; there is no live mode. Point the P1AZ Inspector's Live mode at http://127.0.0.1:4850/pingone (see Connect).

demos.name: Stolen-token LAB
demos.description: Replay a captured access token through a mock gateway and see what stops it: nothing (bearer), audience binding, DPoP (RFC 9449), or mTLS certificate binding (RFC 8705, simulated). Mock mode only; Live is refused.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 4950). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=4950 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root (the folder above this checkout).

demos.name: MCP Elicitation LAB
demos.description: An MCP server mid-tool-call asks the person for more: form mode and URL mode, accept / decline / cancel, -32042, and the spec's safety rules, with findings when a server breaks them. Mock server and mock client; nothing is fetched.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 6800). Docker: HOST_PORT=6800 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials, no outbound call. composeFile is relative to the folder that holds the clone (a placeholder the shelf resolves). Targets MCP spec 2025-11-25; the draft differs (see the page's Spec basis).

demos.name: MCP inspector
demos.description: Connect to an MCP server, list its tools, resources and prompts, scan them, then call tools behind a confirm step. One app with the scanner (D4).

demos.name: MCP scanner
demos.description: Scan the metadata an MCP server serves, or a pasted tools/list snapshot, for tool poisoning before an agent reads it. Reports; never blocks. Same app as the inspector (D3).

demos.name: MCP resource server
demos.description: A config-driven MCP resource server: banking and healthcare verticals defined by files, answered from bundled SQLite, token-protected (RFC 9728). Runs offline; loopback only.

demos.name: Deploy Test LAB
demos.description: Throwaway app that exists to exercise the shelf's one-click Deploy: clone, build, run. One page and a demo-health/1 endpoint. Not part of any demo story.

demos.name: JEV Decision Model LAB
demos.description: Judge an agent's decisions against a policy: attack/innocent/intent corpora, bake-offs between models, a threshold-policy slider. Mock engine or your own model endpoint.

demos.name: OBO Delegation Inspector LAB
demos.description: Seven steps of RFC 8693 on-behalf-of delegation: sub kept, act added, aud+scope narrowed; downstream accepts the delegated token and refuses the person's own. Mock engine or your PingOne tenant.

demos.name: JIT Ephemeral Credentials LAB
demos.description: Standing (30 d) vs just-in-time (300 s, tool-bound) agent credentials; replay the captured copy and watch one stay accepted and the other die; tool revocation. Mock or Real via the shared local PingFederate (rule 20) or your PingOne tenant.

demos.name: Ping Services Stub LAB
demos.description: One stub exercising every shared Ping service the family deploys: shared local PingFederate, PingGateway, Privilege Agent Gateway, PingOne (SaaS), PingOne Privilege console, and the SE-K8s PingFederate. One real, read-only call per service; Mock/Real toggle; reuses shared infra (shared-first rule).

demos.name: A2A Lab
demos.description: A generalist agent hands off to a specialist: two RFC 8693 exchanges build the nested act chain, scope narrowed per hop. The gateway routes the call only when the specialist is registered; an unregistered identity is denied. Mock of UC2/2.5/2.6/2.7.

demos.name: Tarun ID-JAG Runner
demos.description: Runs the PingFederate ID-JAG (cross-app access) demo without Postman: password grant + refresh, RFC 8693 exchange for the ID-JAG assertion, jwt-bearer redeem + introspection, four refusal cases, and a JWKS inspector. Real PingFederate 13.1+ only.

demos.name: Agent Preferences Lab
demos.description: The user sets what their AI agent may do — allowed action tiers, a spend cap, what happens when Protect detects an AI agent — enforced at a mock MCP tool boundary: permit, human approval (HITL) or deny. Standalone mock of the AI-DEMO2 agentPreferences feature. Mock only.

demos.name: Delegation Lab
demos.description: Consent mints a delegated token with act={agent}; the gateway validates the chain (actor allow-list, no upstream audience). Directory groups are read EVERY decision: outside the group is denied regardless of scopes; premium expands tools and ceiling. Mock of UC1/UC9/UC9A/UC21.

demos.name: Demo field guide LAB
demos.description: A JSON-driven card-deck handoff page: edit data/cards.json (title, base URL, sections, cards) and the page renders it. Genericized from the AI-DEMO2 personal-agents handoff page; no baked-in routes or credentials. Each deployment points at its own demo surfaces.

demos.name: Diagram Prove Lab
demos.description: Validated personal-agent (ChatGPT) and digital-assistant diagrams as diagram-studio data, with a Prove-it-live checklist: each token claim (RFC 8693 sub+act, scope narrowing, HITL) maps to a real prompt and its evidence. Movable boxes, Simulate, Reset, Mock/Real toggle.

demos.name: HITL MFA Lab
demos.description: An agent's money movement gated by a mock authorization policy: amount bands decide PERMIT, human consent (HITL), MFA step-up or DENY, and CIBA asks for out-of-band approval on the user's phone. Single-use, amount-bound receipts. Mock of the AI-DEMO2 HITL track (UC7/UC8/UC22).

demos.name: MCP Gateway Lab
demos.description: A third-party weather MCP server scoped at an agent gateway: an admin-editable policy is enforced at the edge, so a denied call never reaches the backend and switching the policy flips the same call with no restart. Mock of the AI-DEMO2 weather-mcp showcase (UC30/31/32).

demos.name: Observability Lab
demos.description: Follow a log line from PingOne, PingFederate and Ping Gateway to a searchable, alertable store, with Privilege sensor and MCP gateway lines too. Seeded mock logs, a query box, three alert rules and a label lab that shows the silent failure of a missing relabel rule. Real reads one loopback Loki.

demos.name: Privilege Logging Lab
demos.description: Drive each Privilege gateway use case and see what gets logged, scored on user, agent, tool and policy decision. Mock replays 17 transactions measured on 2026-11-07; Real (owner-run) sends them to your gateway and reads the log back. The gaps are listed, not hidden.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7801). Mock needs no tenant, key or network. Docker: HOST_PORT=7801 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock by default). Real: set PRIV_LOG_GATEWAY_URL and PRIV_LOG_AGENT_KEY (and optionally PRIV_LOG_SEARCH_URL, PRIV_LOG_SEARCH_INDEX) in ~/Development/.env, then use the Real toggle and confirm the origins. No catalog row matches yet, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row.

demos.name: Field Notes
demos.description: A library of pages about our apps and what we learned: findings, how-tos and investigations, one Markdown file each. Mock shows the sanitized pages shipped in the repo; Real (owner-run, loopback only) shows a local folder of full notes.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7804). Docker: HOST_PORT=7804 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock only). Real: set FIELD_NOTES_DIR in ~/Development/.env to a folder of .md pages outside the repo and run on the host. No catalog row matches yet, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row.

demos.name: Aggregate entitlement lab
demos.description: See how an MCP aggregate lists only the tools each caller may use and refuses the rest by name: six checks, guided steps and a diagram. Mock simulates the Ping release claim (UNVERIFIED on our tenant); Real measures your own gateway's aggregate apps with your agent keys.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm run build, then npm start (port 7802, loopback only). Docker: HOST_PORT=7802 docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:7802 only). Mock needs nothing. Real: set AGG_ENT_GW_URL, AGG_ENT_GW_APPS and AGG_ENT_GW_KEY_<NAME> in ~/Development/.env, then use the Real toggle. Fork of mcp-tools-LAB (its Entitled listing page). Catalog id D125 (owner, 2026-11-08). composeFile is relative to the shelf's demo root.

demos.name: PingOne Events Lab
demos.description: See what PingOne delivers through a webhook subscription: an events page, delivery health (including a site that answers 200 with a web page and silently discards events) and optional forwarding to Elasticsearch for Kibana. Mock needs nothing. Also runs on SE K8 so PingOne can reach it.

demos.name: CIBA HITL Lab
demos.description: Twenty-four steps from scope to tool with a human in the loop: one login, one token exchange, an OBO token that keeps the full scope set; a write is denied with a CIBA identifier, the gateway rewrites the 403 into a JSON-RPC 2.0 error, the human approves, the agent replays, Authorize verifies…

demos.name: Muse
demos.description: A personal agent (Muse) calls tools through a PingOne Privilege-shaped gateway, with a DaVinci-shaped detection flow in front. Simulated: no tenant, no OBO.

demos.name: AgentCore PingOne LAB
demos.description: An AI agent on AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime whose identity comes from PingOne, in mock only: the M2M flow (the agent's own token), the USER_FEDERATION 3LO flow (a human login through the agent, four measured shapes), and on-behalf-of delegation. Mock/Real toggle; Real ships disabled.

demos.name: Meridian Pay A2A hop lab
demos.description: Walk a delegated agent token chain one hop at a time: sign in, hand the job to a platform-signed external agent, exchange tokens (RFC 8693, third-party subject and actor), and call MCP tools through Privilege doors. Every hop shows sub/act/aud/scope, and refusals are demoed on purpose. Runs…

demos.name: AI Gateway Suite LAB
demos.description: Relayed agent chat: preset prompts (access review, prompt injection, jailbreak, exfiltration, PII, tool misuse) travel Main Agent -> AI Gateway (A2A) -> Worker Agent -> AI Gateway (MCP) -> MCP tool on a movable ReactFlow diagram with a per-hop trace and AI Guard blocks; a Personal Agent tab connects

demos.name: Where Everything Runs
demos.description: What is running now, high level to low: AI-DEMO2 by tier and the LAB apps as two systems, then every running server with its links and observed request counts, plus request paths for a sample Personal Agent and Digital Worker. Mock is a sanitized sample; Real reads a snapshot you collect.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7805). Docker: HOST_PORT=7805 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock only). Real (host only): run scripts/collect.sh --running-only, then derive-links.mjs and derive-traces.mjs on the snapshot it wrote (outside the repo), set ENV_MAP_SNAPSHOT in ~/Development/.env, run on the host. Optional files beside the snapshot: env-map.owners.json (AI-DEMO2 vs LAB split), env-map.flows.json, env-map.links.json. Opens on the Landscape view (#/diagram). No catalog row matches yet, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row.

demos.name: PingCLI Lab
demos.description: Watch an admin automate PingOne with Ping CLI: 14 allow-listed, read-only pingcli commands streamed to the browser, an install -> init -> auth -> run guide, and an easy-read table. Mock plays canned output offline; Real runs pinned pingcli 1.2.0 against your own environment.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7806). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Real: PINGONE_ENVIRONMENT_ID, PINGONE_REGION, PINGONE_CLIENT_ID, PINGONE_CLIENT_SECRET in ~/Development/.env (host) or passed through compose (Docker). Derived from the AI-DEMO2 /pingcli page. Catalog id D126 (owner, 2026-11-09).

demos.name: MCP Skills LAB
demos.description: Tests the MCP Skills extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/skills, SEP-2640): a skills server (Mock or Real), 23 hostile cases a correct host must catch, and a host verifier that checks digests, sizes, frontmatter, approvals and origins. Nothing is executed or fetched.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 7807). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock by default; Real reads SKILLS_DIR (read-only mount). No tenant, no credentials, no outbound call. Catalog id D127 (owner, 2026-11-09: next free after D126); no catalog row for it yet, like D123 to D126. UNVERIFIED against a vendor gateway.
